free_tier.stated: 1 GB file storage on Free; 1 GB/month file egress; 0.5 GB database; 40 deployments
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: 1 GB/month data egress total on Free (serving user files, accessing files in functions, backups). Equal to the storage size, so a full store can be fetched exactly once per month.

tooling: Convex client SDKs (JS/Python/Rust), HTTP actions, `npx convex` CLI, `storage.getUrl()` bearer URLs. 'anyone with the URL can access the file' (public, no auth).
chaining: Free/Starter is per TEAM; 40 deployments per team on Free. But file storage is 1 GB total per team, not per deployment. So deployments do not multiply storage. Multiple teams/accounts is the only axis. Upload URLs are one-time and short-lived, which makes external tools awkward.
limits_note: 1 GB storage AND 1 GB egress; HTTP action responses capped at 100 MiB so you cannot proxy large files; file URLs are unrevocable except by deleting the file.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Free has hard resource caps (Starter can exceed with usage-based billing). Well-behaved, no data loss reported; 100 MiB response cap breaks large-file serving via custom routes.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
